note: Pinned raw inputs of Lighting Phase L0. The raw files live in ignored scratch (work/lighting-city-l0/raw/); extract-source.mjs refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs. A re-download is a NEW snapshot and needs a new entry.

osm.accuracy: Mapped geometry, typically metre-level in the city; tag completeness varies (measured in docs/lighting-city-l0/coverage.md). Edit timestamps are not survey dates.

tatorter.licenseSource: https://www.scb.se/omscbse (open statistics and geodata on SCB's geodata platform: CC0 1.0); SCB asks for the source 'Källa: SCB' and that processed data is not presented as SCB's own.
tatorter.attribution: Källa: SCB (Statistiska tätorter 2023), bearbetning: detta projekt
tatorter.accuracy: Statistical delineation of contiguous built-up areas (≥ 200 inhabitants), not a lighting boundary; native CRS EPSG:3006 (requested in EPSG:3006, no reprojection).

nightLights.dataset: NASA Black Marble 2016 (GIBS layer VIIRS_Black_Marble, VIIRS Day/Night Band annual composite, 500 m)
nightLights.license: NASA imagery and data: no restriction on use (U.S. Government work); acknowledgement requested
nightLights.attribution: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA GIBS, Black Marble 2016
nightLights.accuracy: Visualised 8-bit RGB product (not calibrated radiance), one pixel = 15 arc-seconds ≈ 241 m E-W × 463 m N-S here; 2016 predates later LED retrofits. Used only as a district-level plausibility check.
